access.notes: Open-source DFT code; any recent version that supports fully relativistic pseudopotentials and non-collinear SOC.
Norm-conserving pseudopotentials for Sr, Ir, Rh, Mg, Sc, Ti, O with specified cutoff radii (Sr 10.0, Ir 7.0, Rh 7.0, Mg 7.0, Sc 7.0, Ti 7.0, O 5.0 a.u.). Usually part of the OpenMX distribution.

The initial geometric structure of Sr2IrO4 (space group I4/mmm or Cmca) can be obtained from standard materials databases (e.g., ICSD, Materials Project) or from literature. The agent will optimize the structure as part of the workflow.
For Sr2MgIrO6: a=3.958 Å (Ref. 22 in paper). These values are public and can be used directly.
